directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a news report to your campus newspaper on a visit to a local farm organized by your Student Union. You should write at least 120 words but no more than180 words.
sample_essay:
Recently, the Student Union organized a visit to a local farm, which turned out to be an eye-opening and rewarding experience for all participants.

To begin with, upon arrival at the farm, students were warmly welcomed by the farmers. They were given a detailed introduction to the various crops and livestock on the farm. For example, students learned about how different vegetables are grown and the proper ways to take care of them. In addition, students had the chance to participate in hands-on activities. They helped pick fruits and vegetables, which not only gave them a taste of rural labor but also allowed them to understand the hard work behind the food on their plates.

Furthermore, the visit also included a delicious farm-to-table lunch. Students got to enjoy fresh and organic food directly from the farm, which was a treat for their taste buds. 

In conclusion, this visit to the local farm was a great success. It not only provided students with a break from their busy academic lives but also enhanced their understanding of agriculture and rural life.
